name: io.github.TonytheTiger22/payperscreen
title: PayPerScreen
description: Sanctions, crypto wallet, email and IP screening for agents. Pay per check in USDC via x402.

environmentVariables.name: PAYPERSCREEN_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a wallet holding a few dollars of USDC; pays 1 to 2 cents per check. Free tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: PAYPERSCREEN_MAX_SPEND
environmentVariables.description: Maximum USD the server may spend per session (default 1.00).

environmentVariables.name: PAYPERSCREEN_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Where the wallet holds USDC: base (default), polygon or arbitrum.
